body: **Foco:** Hardly / scarcely — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** notícia / reportagem curta.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar hardly… when, scarcely… when e no sooner… than para sequenciar eventos numa notícia sobre um lançamento.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Product Launch Sells Out in Minutes
paras: **Hardly had** the doors opened **when** a crowd rushed in. **Scarcely had** the first customers left **when** the shelves were empty, and **no sooner had** staff restocked **than** the new batch disappeared.
**Hardly anyone** expected such demand: the firm had **barely** produced enough stock. Analysts say the launch could **hardly** have gone better.

items.q: The doors opened before the crowd arrived.
items.why: Hardly had … when a crowd rushed in.

items.q: Staff restocked and the new batch disappeared at once.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Hardly had the doors opened when a crowd rushed in.**
**Scarcely had they left when it rained.**
**No sooner had staff restocked than it sold out.**

blocks.body: Os três significam “**assim que**”: o primeiro evento é no **past perfect**, o segundo no **past simple**. Use **when** com hardly/scarcely e **than** com no sooner.
Não use negativa extra: ~~hardly nobody~~. Diga **hardly anybody**.

items.s: Hardly ___ the doors opened when a crowd rushed in. (had)
Scarcely had they left ___ it rained. (when)
No sooner had staff restocked ___ it sold out. (than)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Fly off the shelves.** — Esgotar rapidamente.
**Sell like hot cakes.** — Vender como água.
**In the nick of time.** — Na hora H.
**No sooner said than done.** — Dito e feito.
**The calm before the storm.** — A calmaria antes da tempestade.
**Rush hour.** — Horário de pico.
**Beat the crowd.** — Chegar antes da multidão.
**Break the record.** — Quebrar o recorde.
**Hardly anyone expected such demand.** — Quase ninguém esperava tanta demanda.
**Hardly had the doors opened when the crowd rushed in.** — Mal as portas abriram, a multidão entrou correndo.
**Scarcely had the first customers left when the shelves were empty.** — Mal os primeiros clientes saíram e as prateleiras estavam vazias.

blocks.title: Launch report
lines: Hardly had the doors opened when the crowd rushed in.
Mal as portas abriram, a multidão entrou correndo.
Scarcely had the first customers left when the shelves were empty.
Mal os primeiros clientes saíram e as prateleiras estavam vazias.
No sooner had staff restocked than it sold out again.
Mal a equipe repôs e esgotou de novo.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: A entonação organiza o discurso: queda = informação completa; subida = há mais por vir; a informação nova recebe o foco (nuclear stress).

prompts.model: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had she arrived than it rained.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence news report using hardly, scarcely and no sooner.
blocks.model: Hardly had the store opened when a crowd rushed in. Scarcely had the first customers left when the shelves were empty. No sooner had staff restocked than the new batch disappeared. Hardly anyone had expected such demand. The firm had barely produced enough stock. Analysts say the launch could hardly have gone better.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
